Use zip(), enumerate(), any() and all().

names = ["Surya", "Amit", "Riya"]
marks = [78, 92, 65]
for name, mark in zip(names, marks):
    print(name, mark)
for i, name in enumerate(names, start=1):
    print(i, name)
print(any(m > 90 for m in marks)) # True -> at least one
print(all(m > 60 for m in marks)) # True -> every one
Note: zip() pairs up lists and stops at the shorter one.
